install_tell: docker run -d --gpus all -p 8080:8080 -v $HOME/.tabby:/data tabbyml/tabby serve --model StarCoder-1B --chat-model Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct --device cuda
misconfig_patterns: GET /v1/health is always unauthenticated — leaks model id, chat_model id, device, version, webserver-enabled flag
GET /v1beta/models is always unauthenticated — enumerates available models
GET /v1beta/server_setting unauthenticated in OSS builds (always) and in EE builds when --no-webserver — leaks indexed repo URLs (git_url), completion/chat config, disable_client_side_telemetry flag
POST /v1/completions accepts optional Bearer — when operator never set a token, endpoint is open compute (LLM-jacking primitive)
POST /v1/chat/completions accepts optional Bearer — same compute-exfil exposure
POST /v1beta/chat/completions legacy alias of /v1/chat/completions (kept since v0.11.0 for backward compat) — same exposure
First-visit admin-account creation on EE webserver — if uninitialized + reachable, anyone can claim admin
--no-webserver flag strips JWT/admin/team layer and reverts to pre-v0.11 open-API mode
TABBY_OWNER_IMPERSONATE_OVERRIDE env var present = maintainer testing backdoor active
config.toml at ~/.tabby/config.toml often contains plaintext upstream API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, OpenRouter)

active_probe.false_positive_check: HealthState JSON contract is Tabby-unique: object with model, chat_model, device, and webserver keys together. /v1beta/server_setting GET returning a JSON object with completion/chat/disable_client_side_telemetry keys is the secondary confirmation. Reject if title=='Tabby' but /v1/health returns non-JSON or 404 (likely Eugeny/tabby terminal product or HackTheBox CTF box, both unrelated).

shodan_dorks.notes: 2026-06-09 correction: original squad-1 dorks were all port:8080-constrained (2-3 hits). http.title:"Tabby" returns 97 (94 dedup) — 30x population expansion. Real port distribution: 9090 dominates (40/94), 8000 (11), 443 (8), 80 (7), 9000 (6), 8080 (5), long-tail. 71.3% Python+gunicorn = real-Tabby signal. Eugeny terminal CVE-2024-55950 product cross-attributes on basic dork via IIS/Windows hosts; use strict with -product:"Windows" to eliminate.

Admin-claim path on uninitialized EE webserver — never POST the admin-creation form; presence of first-visit modal is the finding
